extent.formula: (1981–2010 mean September extent - latest September extent) / 1981–2010 mean September extent

source_snapshot.measurement_boundary: Northern Hemisphere September monthly mean sea-ice extent and area in million square kilometres from NOAA/NSIDC Sea Ice Index Version 4. Extent uses the product 15-percent concentration threshold; September extent is not identical to annual minimum extent, ice thickness, age or season length.

transformations.formula: Latest NOAA/NSIDC Northern Hemisphere September monthly mean sea-ice extent subtracted from the complete 1981–2010 source mean.
Map annual September extent through median / p25 / p10 / p2.5 anchors; map extent deficit and annual loss through the corresponding worse-direction distributions.

receipts.uncertainty: Passive-microwave retrieval, sensor transitions, melt ponds, coastal masks, concentration threshold, near-real-time replacement and weather-driven annual variability affect extent and area. September monthly mean extent is a bounded pan-Arctic retreat indicator; it is not a direct observation of season length, ice thickness, ice age or local-sector retreat.
receipts.freshness: NOAA/NSIDC Sea Ice Index Version 4 September record through 2025; snapshot refreshed 2026-07-31.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: NOAA/NSIDC supplies 47 consistent annual pan-Arctic September extent observations, a complete fixed climatology, current deficit, lower-tail position, momentum and quantified fraction of reference extent lost.
